name: London Project affiliate layout standard v8 - Coupang 5 health + 5 K-Beauty, three header partners
selection_principles: Every destination has exactly ten Coupang Partners product cards: five health functional food/wellness products and five K-Beauty skincare products.
All ten product cards use Coupang Partners account-generated tracking links and permitted product images. No Olive Young or Trip.com product cards.
Each destination keeps its own catalog of ten unique products; the same set is reused until the weekly review replaces selected items.
Header buttons are separate from product cards and appear in this exact order: Coupang Partners, Trip.com, OLIVE YOUNG.
Each header button uses its own authorized affiliate tracking URL and approved brand asset.
Do not invent links, images, prices, popularity, sales, reviews, or commission rates.
Preserve article body, status, publication date, featured image and SEO metadata; update only the managed affiliate area.
Display the Coupang logo with the product cards only using the official permitted asset; do not distort or recolor it and do not make it a hyperlink.

Disclose that purchases made within 24 hours after a visitor enters Coupang through the affiliate link, including purchases of other eligible products, may generate commission; attribution rules, cancellations and returns can affect eligibility.
Never claim every click or purchase guarantees commission.
